subject: Bridgeport hosting guardrails and pilot credit request
messages:
From: Ava Scott <ava.scott@bridgeport.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Hosting & audit constraints for pilot

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — Bridgeport is excited about Redwood's latency profile. We are moving a small pilot (3 months, ~25k tokens/day) that must run in a dedicated private deployment. Two constraints we need to confirm before we proceed:

1) Data residency: all customer data (and backups) must remain in eu-west-1.
2) Audit modality: our compliance team requires an annual audit but will only accept a timeboxed, on-site-style review limited to 48 hours per year; we cannot provide full host-level access or persistent root keys.

Given this (and that the pilot budget is constrained), Bridgeport is requesting a pilot credit of 25% off list and that KMS integration allows us to bring our own keys (BYOK). Is Redwood able to accommodate these guardrails and the discount? If so, we'll send the legal contact and the SOC artifacts needed.

Best,
Ava
Ava Scott
Head of Cloud Ops, Bridgeport AI
ava.scott@bridgeport.ai
+1 415-555-0198
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Ava Scott <ava.scott@bridgeport.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-05T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosting & audit constraints for pilot

Hi Ava — great to hear. We can support a Private (VPC) deployment in eu-west-1 and BYOK for KMS; that part is straightforward. Audit access is the part that needs a scoped exception.

Proposed next steps (mutual action plan):
- Bridgeport: confirm exact scope of data and name of legal/compliance contact (this week).
- Redwood: we will propose a scoped audit approach (read-only logs + a 48-hour window, no host-level credentials).
- Pricing: I will escalate the 25% pilot credit request — typical pilot credits land between 10–20% depending on hosting concessions.

Laura and Karthik — looping you in for quick review and exec sign-off if needed. Ava, can you also confirm whether the 48-hour window is continuous or can be split over multiple days?

Thanks,
Jordan
Product Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-05T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Bridgeport hosting & audit constraints — recommendation + redlines attached

Internal — attaching the customer's redlines and my recommended concession set. Key points:

- Recommend we allow a 48-hour timeboxed audit window limited to read-only access to application logs and system audit logs. No SSH, no host keys, no persistent credentials.
- Require Bridgeport to sign an execution addendum that includes an explicit non-repudiation clause and limits the number of auditors to 2 people for the pilot.
- BYOK accepted, but keys must be provisioned via our KMS-onboarding flow and escrow options discussed with Security.
- In exchange: a 20% pilot credit (not 25%) plus a 12-month minimum commitment post-pilot to qualify.

Attachments: bridgeport_sla_redlines.pdf

Asks: Karthik — please confirm if 20% + timeboxed audit is acceptable as a Deal Desk-approved concession or whether this needs exec (CRO/CFO) signoff.

Thanks,
Laura
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-05T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Bridgeport hosting & audit constraints — recommendation + redlines attached

Laura / Jordan — reviewed. Approve as Deal Desk:

- Concede to the 48-hour, read-only audit window (no host access).
- Accept BYOK via our onboarding flow; Security to confirm escrow and rotation policy in writing.
- Approve a 20% pilot credit contingent on: execution addendum signed, 12-month committed term if pilot converts, and Bridgeport covers any on-site audit travel costs.

Please proceed to Legal for the precise addendum language and route the final agreement for e-signature. Document the exception in the Deal Exception tracker (deal_id: DBL-2026-0197).

Karthik
Head of Deal Desk | Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Ava Scott <ava.scott@bridgeport.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-05T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Bridgeport hosting & audit constraints for pilot — approved terms

Ava — quick update: internal approval secured. Summary of approved terms for the pilot:

1) Hosting: Private (VPC) deployment in eu-west-1 with BYOK (customer-managed keys via our onboarding flow).
2) Audit: One annual, timeboxed 48-hour window limited to read-only access to application and audit logs. No host-level credentials, no SSH. Auditors limited to two named individuals; Bridgeport to cover travel if on-site is requested.
3) Commercial: 20% pilot credit (applied to the first three months) in exchange for a 12-month committed term if the pilot converts.

Next steps:
- I'll attach the execution plan and redlines (see attachments).
- Legal will send an addendum (DocuSign link) for signature; please have your legal team review.
- Once signed, we'll schedule a kickoff and the KMS onboarding call.

Expected attachments: bridgeport_sla_redlines.pdf, bridgeport_execution_plan.xlsx
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/bridgeport/p/12345-approve

Appreciate the fast turnaround — will keep you posted on Legal timing.

Best,
Jordan
Product Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
